data.long_meaning: The name Ernesto is derived from the Old Germanic words eran (to earn) and stan (to stand or make to stand). It means 'to serve the earnest' or 'to serve the steadfast'. In Christian tradition, it is a name given to those who are devoted and steadfast in their faith.
